resources.string: In order to install mods and cheats, you must select a folder that contains a cheats/, romfs/, or exefs/ directory. We can\'t verify if these will be compatible with your game so be careful! Dual screen companions (.dsmod.zip files) are installed with Install → Dual screen mods instead.
Please make sure that the directory you selected contains a cheats/, romfs/, or exefs/ folder and try again. For a dual screen companion (.dsmod.zip), use Install → Dual screen mods.
